layout.automated: Automated email about your NAUCTO account. Replies to this address are not read.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.preheader: One last step: confirm your email to save, publish and play with friends.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.intro: Hi {name}, thanks for signing up. Confirm your email address to save, publish and play with friends.
verifyEmail.expiry: This link works once and expires in {hours} hours.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you didn’t create an account, you can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.preheader: Choose a new password for your Naucto account.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: Hi {name}, someone asked to reset the password of your account. Choose a new one with the button below.
resetPassword.expiry: This link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. Every device signed in to your account is signed out when the password changes.
resetPassword.ignore: If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

notification.settings: You can stop these emails in Settings → Account.
